Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From balança +‎ -ar.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [bə.lənˈsa]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [ba.lanˈsaɾ]
  • Rhymes: -a(ɾ)

Verb

[edit]

balançar (first-person singular present balanço, first-person singular preterite balancí, past participle balançat)

  1. (transitive) to balance
    Synonym: balancejar

Portuguese

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • balangar (Brazil, informal, dialectal)

Etymology

[edit]

From balança +‎ -ar.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ba.lɐ̃ˈsa(ʁ)/ [ba.lɐ̃ˈsa(h)]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ba.lɐ̃ˈsa(ʁ)/ [ba.lɐ̃ˈsa(h)]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /ba.lɐ̃ˈsa(ɾ)/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /ba.lɐ̃ˈsa(ʁ)/ [ba.lɐ̃ˈsa(χ)]
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /ba.lɐ̃ˈsa(ɻ)/
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /bɐ.lɐ̃ˈsaɾ/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /bɐ.lɐ̃ˈsaɾ/
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /bɐ.lɐ̃ˈsa.ɾi/

Verb

[edit]

balançar (first-person singular present balanço, first-person singular preterite balancei, past participle balançado)

  1. to swing; to rock, sway
  2. to balance
    Synonyms: balancear, equilibrar
